The given Y = sum X_i^2 / sum X_{j+6}^2 = U/V. That is not (U/6)/(V/6)? Since dividing numerator and denominator by same 6, U/V = (U/6)/(V/6). Yes exactly. So Y ~ F(6,6). Option D. content:
设  
\[
U=\sum_{i=1}^6 \left(\frac{X_i}{\sigma}\right)^2,\qquad 
V=\sum_{j=1}^6 \left(\frac{X_{j+6}}{\sigma}\right)^2
\]
由于 \(X_i\sim N(0,\sigma^2)\) 且相互独立，因此
\[
U\sim \chi^2(6),\quad V\sim \chi^2(6)
\]
且 \(U,V\) 独立。

题目中的随机变量为
\[
Y=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^6X_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^6X_{j+6}^2}
=\frac{U}{V}
\]
又因为
\[
\frac{U/6}{V/6}=\frac{U}{V}
\]
而
\[
\frac{U/6}{V/6}\sim F(6,6)
\]
所以
\[
Y\sim F(6,6)
\]

答案：D
